All 1329 tests pass (1328 previous + 1 new regression test).

## Summary

Fixed `attrs.Converter` and `attrs.converters.pipe()` incorrectly inferring parameter/return types when a wrapped converter is itself a `Converter` instance (i.e. running "in adapter mode" — `takes_self`/`takes_field`). Previously, `pipe()` introspected the `Converter` wrapper's `__call__` (a bound dispatch method with no annotations) instead of the underlying user callable, silently dropping type info.

- `src/attr/_make.py`: `Converter.__init__` now caches `_return_type` alongside the existing `_first_param_type`; `pipe()` reads `._first_param_type`/`._return_type` off nested `Converter` instances directly instead of re-inspecting their `__call__`.
- `tests/test_converters.py`: added a regression test.
- `changelog.d/1331.change.md`: changelog fragment.
